eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Twelve
subtitle: Lesson 114 · Data Warehouse Concepts

code:
SELECT d.CalendarYear, p.EnglishProductName,
       c.FirstName + ' ' + c.LastName AS CustomerName,
       f.SalesAmount
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS f
JOIN dbo.DimDate AS d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
JOIN dbo.DimProduct AS p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
JOIN dbo.DimCustomer AS c ON c.CustomerKey = f.CustomerKey;
caption: Every join goes FACT → dimension, directly. Never dimension-to-dimension.

steps.label: ONE HOP
steps.sub: every dimension joins directly to the fact — never to each other

code:
-- A star-schema dimension flattens related attributes
-- together, unlike a fully-normalized OLTP table (Ch11, 3NF)
SELECT ProductKey, EnglishProductName, ProductSubcategoryKey
FROM dbo.DimProduct;
caption: A deliberate 3NF violation — fewer joins, faster aggregates, and dimensions are small enough it barely costs anything.

subtitle: What happens when dimensions get normalized back.
